original.statement: The 0.16 upgrade guide states that installations where the helm chart installs the CRDs (`installCRDs=true`, the chart default) — including argocd or flux managing the CRDs directly with helm — need only `helm repo update` and `helm upgrade <your_app_name> external-secrets/external-secrets --version 0.16.1`, and that this "should just work" with no further steps.

decision.reason: [ev-dcd7685c65da] says that when CRDs are installed through Helm (installCRDs=true, the default), including through argocd or flux, the normal `helm repo update` and `helm upgrade` "should just work". It names no extra operator step and no changed subject. This is reassurance about the usual upgrade path, not a required migration, so "helm-upgrade-crds (migration-required)" claims mandatory work the evidence doesn't support. No other change assertion follows from this text.
